description: This React component named 'VersionList' manages version display, creation, and restoration for a project, interacting with external API functions (createProjectVersion, listProjectVersions, restoreProjectVersion). It maintains internal state for version data, loading, errors, and messages, providing a UI for snapshot management.

classes.name: VersionItem
classes.description: TypeScript type defining the shape of a version item, including number, created_at, and message.

methods.name: load
methods.description: Asynchronously loads the list of project versions from external API.

methods.name: snapshot
methods.description: Creates a new project version with an optional message and reloads the versions list.

methods.name: restore
methods.description: Restores a specific project version by number and reloads the versions list.
